devices_method: Roles taken from the official web flasher catalog (https://flasher.meshcore.io/config.json) matched against the flasher's live release feed (https://flasher.meshcore.io/releases?repo=github). 'companion' = Companion BLE and/or USB build exists; 'room_server' listed where a build exists. Hardware facts (gps/screen/battery/915) come only from the maker page in maker_url as fetched 2026-10-28. 'no' means the maker spec text was read and lists no such feature; 'optional' means the maker sells it as an add-on/variant.

devices.name: Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 V3
devices.form_factor: Small dev board (ESP32-S3 + SX1262) with onboard OLED
devices.battery_connector_or_builtin: connector (SH1.25-2 lithium battery interface; no battery included)
devices.notes: Onboard 0.96-inch 128x64 OLED. LoRa band options listed: 433, 470-510, 863-870, 902-928 MHz. No GNSS listed in spec table. Optional plastic shell.

devices.name: Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 V4
devices.flasher_name: Heltec v4 (also separate 'Heltec v4 R8' and 'Heltec v4 + Expansion Kit (Touch)' entries)
devices.form_factor: Small dev board (ESP32-S3 + SX1262) with protected OLED; pin-compatible with V3
devices.gps: optional (1.25-8Pin GNSS interface on board; module not built in)
devices.battery_connector_or_builtin: connector (1.25x2 Pin lithium battery) plus 1.25x2 Pin solar input (4.7-6V)
devices.notes: Maker page title: 'WiFi LoRa 32(V4.3) ... Meshtastic, MeshCore and LoRaWAN Compatible'. FAQ states simultaneous 868/915 MHz support. High-power version 28 dBm. Version without OLED available on request per FAQ.

devices.name: Heltec Mesh Node T114 (Rev. 2.0)
devices.battery_connector_or_builtin: connector (2x1.25 lithium battery) plus 2x1.25 solar panel connector
devices.notes: LoRa band options 433, 470-510, 863-870, 902-928 MHz. Page text references MeshCore.

devices.name: Heltec Wireless Paper
devices.form_factor: Small dev board with 2.13-inch e-ink display (ESP32 + SX1262)
devices.battery_connector_or_builtin: connector (SH1.25x2 battery connector included; lithium battery or USB-C power)
devices.notes: 2.13-inch, 122x250 e-ink. LoRa band options 433, 470-510, 863-870, 902-928 MHz. No GNSS listed.

devices.name: Heltec MeshPocket
devices.form_factor: Pocket device built into a Qi2 magnetic charging power bank (nRF52840 + SX1262) with e-ink display
devices.battery_connector_or_builtin: built-in (5000 mAh or 10000 mAh power bank)
devices.notes: 2.13-inch e-ink display. LoRa band options 863-870 and 902-928 MHz. Supports 5/7.5/10/15 W wireless charging. GPS not mentioned in extracted page text.

devices.name: LILYGO T-Deck Plus
devices.form_factor: Handheld with 2.8-inch IPS LCD (keyboard handheld; see notes)
devices.notes: Maker page: 'Upgraded based on T-Deck, mainly added GPS module, and Built-in 2000 mah battery'; 915MHz variants H737-A and H737-03 (external antenna) listed (shown sold out/unavailable when checked). The flasher entry is named 'LilyGo T-Deck' (community companion/repeater builds; no v1.18.0 room-server build matched); meshcore.io lists T-Deck Plus. The word 'keyboard' only appeared in a customer review in the extracted text, not in the spec list. Ripple (freemium) GUI firmware also offered in the flasher for this device.

devices.name: LILYGO T-Echo
devices.notes: L76K GNSS (GPS/GLONASS/BeiDou/QZSS). 200x200 e-paper. 915MHz and 915MHz BME280 variants listed. Flasher also lists T-Echo Lite and T-Echo Card.

devices.name: LILYGO T-Beam
devices.form_factor: Dev board with 18650 battery holder and GPS
devices.screen: optional (0.96-inch OLED, soldered or non-soldered variants)
devices.notes: Maker page describes NEO-6M GPS and SX1276/SX1278 radio; flasher has separate SX1262 and SX1276 entries, so buyers must match radio chip to firmware. For the SX1262 entry, v1.18.0 had companion BLE (no USB) builds. Flasher also lists T-Beam Supreme and T-Beam 1W.

devices.name: Seeed SenseCAP Card Tracker T1000-E
devices.notes: Mediatek AG3335 GNSS; LR1110 LoRa 863-928 MHz (covers US 915 band; no separate US SKU). Page does not mention a display or MeshCore (Meshtastic-branded). Seeed page shows a 'United States Warehouse' option.

devices.name: Seeed Wio Tracker L1 Pro
devices.flasher_name: Seeed Studio Wio Tracker L1 Pro
devices.form_factor: Rugged handheld/mobile node with OLED, battery and enclosure
devices.notes: L76K GPS; LoRa 862-930 MHz; nRF52840. Ripple GUI firmware also offered in flasher. Flasher separately lists 'Wio Tracker L1 EINK'. Seeed also sells L1 (OLED, no case) and L1 Lite (no screen).

devices.name: Seeed XIAO nRF52840 & Wio-SX1262 Kit
devices.notes: Page states LoRa 862-930 MHz. No screen, battery or dimensions stated on the page as fetched. Flasher also lists Xiao S3 WIO and Xiao C3.

devices.name: RAK WisBlock Meshtastic Starter Kit (RAK4631)

Battery/GPS details not stated in extracted text (battery mentioned only in a customer review). Flasher also lists WisMesh Tag, WisMesh 1W Booster, RAK3112.

devices.flasher_name: Seeed Studio SenseCAP Solar Node P1
devices.notes: Built from XIAO nRF52840 Plus + Wio-SX1262 + XIAO L76K GPS. The non-Pro 'Solar Node P1' is sold without GPS and battery. Frequency range not captured from page text.

devices.notes: Spec: 'SX1262 LoRa Module, US 915MHz/EU 868MHz'. Elecrow site has a MeshCore category; flasher also lists ThinkNode M2-M7 and M9 (M9 Ripple GUI only).
